host_boundaries.source: Complete original Secondary and native transform/factory/locator/Bbox classes execute in the accepted numeric graphical-constructor/style/aspect host.
host_boundaries.typed: Direct native Affine2DBase replacement-only immutable profile, plus None reset. Constructor and setter reject whole-matrix nonseparability after location metadata assignment.
host_boundaries.source_only: Generic composite/wrapper/base Transform provenance, original in-place mutable graph aliases, and the four Bbox primitive comparisons are retained without typed API parity claims.
host_boundaries.capture: Current positioned operation captures the old installed locator before scalar forward callback. New replacement applies to the next candidate; native old-T in-place mutation remains source-only.
host_boundaries.errors: Exact native class/message and surviving state retained. Existing Core InvalidTicks error variant is asserted; no new message-text contract.
host_boundaries.nonfinite: Diagonal/translation NaN and infinities are accepted, then actual native deferred Bbox executes; NaN classification and strict finite/infinite bits are asserted without full SVG requirements.
